rules.en: Use concise, active voice, idiomatic cybersecurity and CTF writeup phrasing. Keep register names, assembly mnemonics, function names, and variable names untranslated.
rules.ja: Use natural Japanese technical blog style (Qiita/Zenn CTF writeups). Use 'だ・である' copula. Prefer standard Katakana loanwords for cybersecurity/reverse engineering terms rather than awkward direct translation.
